'''Air Alderaan''' was a travel agency that was a member of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]]. It served as an official spaceline of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the company offered daily nonstop trips to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on board a fleet of [[Air Alderaan StarSpeeder 1000|customized]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]]s. At the time, Air Alderaan operated a [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] terminal on [[Spaceport THX1138]]'s south wing.
